Only .png and .jpg images are meant to be accepted; an upload named portrait.html would be served as a page from our own origin. Analyze this component only.

from pathlib import Path


def store_avatar(upload_dir: Path, filename: str, data: bytes) -> Path:
    """Save an uploaded profile picture under the public upload directory."""
    destination = upload_dir / filename
    destination.write_bytes(data)
    return destination

from pathlib import Path

import avatars


def test_stores_png_avatar(tmp_path: Path):
    saved = avatars.store_avatar(tmp_path, "me.png", b"png-bytes")
    assert saved.read_bytes() == b"png-bytes"
